entry.title: The week in free proxies: Oct 19 – Oct 26, 2026
entry.content:
42,989 different type://ip:port entries passed every check at least once (many are ports on the same host). Of the 42,024 that left the list again, 91 % were not on the next list, and 23 (under 0.1 %) had been on it for 24 runs in a row (about a day) or more. 68 proxies on the list right now have been on it for 24 runs in a row or more.

In the last run Amazon let 7 % of the 332 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 3 % of datacenter exits, 13 % of the other exits.
In the last run Instagram let 13 % of the 332 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 7 % of datacenter exits, 21 % of the other exits.
In the last run TikTok let 67 % of the 273 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 78 % of datacenter exits, 54 % of the other exits.
In the last run Discord let 91 % of the 231 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 92 % of datacenter exits, 91 % of the other exits.
Between 411 and 4,310 entries were on the list at any one time. Right now: 965, 61 % of them tunnel HTTPS to the test host, 53 % are datacenter exits (the provider name looks like a hosting company).
Downloading 100 KB through the HTTPS-capable ones, counting the downloads that finished: half manage 32 KiB/s or more, the fastest tenth over 135 KiB/s.
Most exit IPs are in United States (309), Indonesia (86), India (69), Brazil (56), France (54).
